unit: responding person, conditioned on household-reported expense difficulty
weight: PWEIGHT with PWEIGHT1-PWEIGHT80 successive-difference replicate weights

coding.expense_difficulty: EXPNS_DIF: 1 not at all, 2 a little, 3 somewhat, 4 very difficult
coding.online_search_fields: AI4_1, AI4_2, AI4_4, AI4_5, AI4_6, AI4_8; selected versus not selected, with missing codes excluded
coding.ai_trust: AI2_5 selected statement that the respondent trusts information from AI systems, among AI users with a valid response
coding.ai_opt_out: AI3 active opt-out response among valid responses

interpretation: Same-round weighted conditional shares. Expense difficulty is household-reported; online searches and AI attitudes are respondent/household reports. No causal, longitudinal, event-level, or AI-mediated search interpretation is permitted.
boundary: The file does not identify a specific bill, actor, search result, alternative, remedy, outcome, or later trust/action change. Online search, AI use, AI trust, and opt-out remain separate constructs.
